candidates.description: This feature vector represents common Italian adverbial, nominal, and adjectival modifiers related to quantity, time, and existence.
This feature vector represents Italian prepositional articles and contracted prepositions that indicate spatial and relational context.
This feature vector activates strongly on prominent historical thinkers, philosophers, scientists, and cultural figures.
This feature vector represents concepts related to science, physics, and scientific research.
This vector represents Romance language roots and suffixes commonly found in adjectives and verbs related to complexity, possibility, and association.
This vector represents traditional European given names.
This vector activates strongly for subword tokens starting with the letters "Tr" or "tra".
This vector represents adjectival prefixes, suffixes, and root morphemes related to state, degree, and quality.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the phonetic or orthographic sequence related to the German word "Freud" or the English words "free" and "fun."
This feature vector activates strongly on words and proper nouns related to lamentation, sorrow, or biblical figures with names of Hebrew origin.
